name: loom-observability-backend
description: Cloudflare Workers reference backend (ingest + storage) for the Loom fleet observability epic (#4702, Phase 2) plus the Phase-3 dashboard UI in web/, served from the same Worker as static assets. Accepts pushed telemetry batches from loom-daemon's HttpsExporter, authenticates per-host, persists durable history to D1, and maintains live fleet state in a Durable Object.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm --prefix web run check
